changes: Scribe: as_written extended to 'śarmagaṇgādharakaraḍiyādhīmāṃ'; 'Karaḍiyā' (probably the Karāḍa/Karhāḍā brahmin group or a family name) added to titles and affiliation; 'dhīmān' is an epithet, not part of the name; confidence lowered to medium because the compound is irregular
Date: tithi read as 'tithe ṛtu-divase' (ṛtu = 6), i.e. ṣaṣṭhī, instead of the raw corrupt string
Date: month normalised to Mārgaśīrṣa, pakṣa to kṛṣṇa (vadī), weekday to Wednesday (jñavāra = Budhavāra); 'ūrjjage sūrye' (sun in Ūrja/Kārttika) and lagna Kumbha (ghaṭa) added to nakshatra_yoga
Date: chronogram read right to left as rūpa = 1, (a)ga = 7, agni = 3, kha = 0, giving ŚS 1730 tentatively; ce_approx set to 1808?
Purpose rephrased: recitation for victory and for good sons and grandsons

date.as_written: śāke khāgnigarūpabheditiśubhe yoge jñavārorjjage sūrye mārgavadī tithert(!) tudivase lagne ghaṭa(!) saṃyute
date.year: 1730? (kha 0, agni 3, (a)ga 7?, rūpa 1; read right to left)
date.nakshatra_yoga: śubha yoga (or simply 'auspicious'); sun in Ūrja (Kārttika); lagna Kumbha (ghaṭa)

purpose: for constant recitation, for victory and for good sons and grandsons (satputrapautrārthakaiḥ)
notes: The chronogram 'khāgnigarūpa' is unclear. Kha = 0, agni = 3 and rūpa = 1 are secure. 'ga' is probably 'aga' (mountain = 7), which gives ŚS 1730 = c. 1808 CE. The catalogue gives only ŚS 1?30, so the middle digit and the CE date are tentative. 'bhediti' is probably a corruption of 'bhedite'. 'tithert(!) tudivase' is read as 'tithe ṛtu-divase' (6th tithi). 'ūrjjage sūrye' puts the sun in Ūrja (Kārttika), which sits oddly with lunar Mārga vadī unless the months are reckoned differently (amānta/pūrṇimānta). The verse is corrupt and pāda c is unmetrical (cataloguer's note). 'Karaḍiyā' is most likely the Karāḍa (Karhāḍā) brahmin group or a family name. 'dhīmān' is an epithet. 'paṭhet sarvadā' is a generic phala statement: it names no reader or owner.
